rationale: Spotify explicitly states content is 'licensed, not sold' but buries this in dense legal text while marketing uses 'purchase.' The terms combine aggressive restrictions—mandatory individual arbitration, class action waiver, $30 liability cap, unilateral termination without refund, and content removal without notice—that heavily favor Spotify and obscure consumer rights.
evidence_quotes: The Spotify software applications and the Content are licensed, not sold or transferred to you
limited, non-exclusive, revocable permission to make personal, non-commercial use
AGGREGATE LIABILITY... MORE THAN THE GREATER OF (A) THE AMOUNTS PAID BY YOU... OR (B) $30.00
YOU AND SPOTIFY AGREE THAT EACH MAY BRING CLAIMS... ONLY IN YOUR INDIVIDUAL CAPACITY AND NOT AS A CLASS MEMBER
Spotify may... stop providing all or part of the Spotify Service without notice or liability
